results.title: A Reading of the US Midterm Election Results
results.description: Contrary to the celebratory reaction with which a considerable segment of Arab public opinion greeted the results of the US midterm elections, a political reading requires some patience. The Republicans’ loss of their majority does not mean that the United States has abandoned its interests, nor that the American voter went to the ballot box to settle Middle Eastern disputes.

results.title: 'More you connect with locals, weaker enemy’s plots become': Rajnath Singh's message to troops in WB's Bagdogra
results.description: Defence minister Rajnath Singh addressed soldiers in Bagdogra, urging them to connect with local residents for security. He highlighted that strong connections could weaken enemy plots in sensitive border regions. Singh emphasized the significance of discipline and courage for every soldier in the armed forces. He stated that high morale among soldiers is essential for achieving victories, even with limited resources.
